internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 12:36 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the cart service, reaching 50%. Logs and traces indicated Valkey connection errors, and the cartFailure flag was active at 50%, correlating with the errors. The diagnosis confirmed an error injection in the cart service as the root cause. 

The remediation action was to disable the cartFailure flag at 12:56 UTC, which was approved and executed promptly. Post-action monitoring verified recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels (0.002). The incident was resolved shortly after.

No queue backlog was detected, and dependency issues in the checkout service were considered but not supported by evidence.

This incident highlights the importance of monitoring feature flags and their impact on service stability.

external.body: Between 12:36 and 12:56 UTC on November 8, 2026, some customers experienced errors when using the cart service. Our team identified the issue and took corrective action to restore normal service. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are working to prevent similar issues in the future.
